name: Supplementary data for manuscript: "Unveiling GruPol: Predicting electric and electrostatic properties of macromolecules via building block approach"
description: This dataset contains files for executing GruPol database as well testing files. Folders: 1) GruPol - running database 2) test1 - contains a PDB file for running GruPol (atom labels must follow CHARMM force field) 3) test2 - contains a PolaBer output file for running CrysPol. The given CIF file provides the necessary information concerning crystal symmetry for testing. 4) proteins_validation_coordinates - provides the coordinates of the molecules used to benchmark GruPol. (2024-09-01) – IMPORTANT UPDATE (2025–07–01): A new version of GruPol is available at: https://github.com/raphafe96/Thesis-VisPol. We have kept the old version here for compatibility with the paper; however, we encourage users to check out the new version, which includes documentation and a user guide.
